status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 58% fewer than the week before, most of them in Darfur, Khartoum and Kordofan.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 58 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Darfur, Khartoum og Kordofan.

summary.en: The Sudanese army has seized Bakori and Sali and is advancing in West Kordofan while the Rapid Support Forces continue drone attacks that have killed civilians in the Blue Nile and White Nile regions, including a strike that killed nine civilians in the Blue Nile. The army reported shooting down a hostile drone in West Kordofan. A senior RSF commander defected to the army after 13 years of service. Drones now account for two thirds of child casualties in the conflict. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren har erobret Bakori og Sali og gjør fremrykk i Vest-Kordofan, mens RSF-militsen fortsetter droneangrep som har drept sivile i Blue Nile og White Nile, inkludert et angrep som drepte ni sivile i Blue Nile. Hæren rapporterte at de skjøt ned en fiendtlig drone i Vest-Kordofan. En høytstående RSF-kommandør deserterte til hæren etter 13 år i tjeneste. Droner står nå for to tredjedeler av barnas dødsfall i konflikten. 4 680 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
